symptom: A controlled main-instance restart timed out because port 49977 remained occupied after Supervisor termination.

dynamic_evidence.failure: backend/frontend port did not become free after stop: 49977

root_cause: InstanceSupervisor._signal_pid called os.killpg(pid, signal), assuming the registered backend PID was also the process-group leader. RTK and other wrappers can make the backend a child whose PGID differs from its PID, so the signal targeted a nonexistent group and termination became a no-op.

fix.behavior: Reuse KernelOne signal_process_tree, which resolves os.getpgid(pid) and terminates the actual group; retain direct-PID signal only as a defensive fallback.

verification.unit: Instance Supervisor delegates TERM and KILL semantics to KernelOne process-tree authority.
verification.live_pending: Repeat controlled restart and prove 49977 changes PID/source fingerprint without touching 5173.
